method: OpenStreetMap node 4425992583, used verbatim (a point of interest, not a building footprint). A search of OpenStreetMap for the literal string 'NM4' returns nothing, but a search for the experiment's own name ('SeaQuest') finds this node, tagged name=SeaQuest and addr:housenumber=NM4 (fetched 2026-09-21 from https://api.openstreetmap.org/api/0.6/node/4425992583.json). accuracy_m is 10 m, the floor for an OpenStreetMap point or building-scale feature; the feature type is 'other' (not 'hall') because this is a single address-point node, not a traced building footprint.
